Overview
The Presidential System and Its Applicability in Turkey is a research paper later turned into book dealing with presidential form of governance and constitutional issues, framed in a comparative approach. The paper has been cited in relation to the debate over presidentialism in Türkiye and in literature reviews published in various research papers pertaining to constitutional changes and relationships between the executive and legislative branches of government.
Academic usage
The book has been referenced and debated in Turkish constitutional law and political science literature about the government systems, presidentialism and constitutional reform in Türkiye. It has been mentioned in comparative studies of parliamentary and presidential systems, discussions on proposals to introduce a "Turkish-type presidential system" and the analysis of the 2017 constitutional amendments.
Publication history
The book was first published in 1997 by Alfa Yayınları.
A second edition was released in 2013 by Adalet Yayınevi.
A third edition was released in March 2016 by Der Yayınları.
